qaAllow.joint:hip.L.rot: Ananda Balasana: hips deeply flexed and abducted, knees out wider than the torso and drawn down beside the ribs, shins near vertical. qa-lib measures rotation from a direct swing out of standing (Codman offset), which reads about 150 deg here; done as flexion, horizontal abduction, then rotation it is about 60-80 deg. Not a flipped knee.
qaAllow.joint:hip.R.rot: Ananda Balasana: hips deeply flexed and abducted, knees out wider than the torso and drawn down beside the ribs, shins near vertical. qa-lib measures rotation from a direct swing out of standing (Codman offset), which reads about 150 deg here; done as flexion, horizontal abduction, then rotation it is about 60-80 deg. qaAllow.joint:hip.L.range: Ananda Balasana: the thigh about 147-151 deg from hanging toward the armpit with the knee out to the side (deep flexion plus abduction), the knee beside the ribs and not inside them; a flexible person reaches it, qa-lib caps that plane at about 124.
